text: Don't touch the brass one. Or the green jar. Or anything that's ticking.
Wick. Tinker. Brinehollow's only, which makes me the best and the worst at once.

menu.text: What can I fix, build or set on fire for you?

choices.text: Where do blueprints and parts come from?

text: Smoke pellets, tar bombs, grapples, spring boots, a glider if you've the nerve. Tricks on your belt for when a blade won't do.
A captain who fights fair loses to one who doesn't. That's not advice, that's arithmetic.
At a workbench. Mine's right there. Carry a blueprint to one and you study it: learned for good, the scroll used up.
Then pick what to build and pay in parts. Once your ship's yours, there's a bench on her deck too.
Blueprints are scrolls. Chests, wrecks, merchants, and tinkers like me who owe you one.
Parts are salvage, ore and the bits of beasts nobody wants. Open every chest. Pick up everything. Tinkers are magpies with debts.
What you build goes on your belt. {key_gadget} throws or fires the one in hand, {key_gadget_cycle} turns to the next.
Each has charges. Spent? Refill it at a bench with parts. Cheaper than building, dearer than not wasting them.
Mark two, mark three. More charges, more bang, longer smoke. Each wants a steadier hand.
Your Tinkering grows every time you build or refill. Keep at it and the bench stops saying no.

bye.text: Mind the door. It sticks. On purpose. Long story.
